source.check: python tools/golden/d3fend_check.py --ontology <d3fend.json> verifies every id and name below against the pinned ontology

rule: an active claim needs >= 1 active attack scenario proving it fires and >= 1 active benign scenario proving it stays quiet; a planned claim names its phase

claims.name: Connection Attempt Analysis
claims.how: port / lateral scan and connection-abuse detectors (Zeek conn), ARP sweep

claims.name: Decoy Network Resource
claims.how: internal decoy host; contact is an owner-named single-signal exception

claims.name: Domain Name Reputation Analysis
claims.how: optional feeds / VirusTotal per domain; never 'clean' when unavailable

claims.name: DNS Denylisting
claims.how: Pi-hole blocks, only on a contained verdict

claims.name: DNS Traffic Analysis
claims.how: DGA, tunnelling, rate, resolver-bypass detectors

claims.name: IP Reputation Analysis
claims.how: optional feeds / AbuseIPDB per address; curated feed match is an owner-named exception

claims.name: Network Isolation
claims.how: router isolation / tarpit through the containment gate

claims.name: Network Traffic Analysis
claims.how: Zeek-derived beaconing, notices, ARP observations

claims.name: Network Traffic Community Deviation
claims.how: peer-cohort deviation (context) and cross-device coordinated targeting

claims.name: Network Traffic Policy Mapping
claims.how: geofencing policy

claims.name: Network Traffic Signature Analysis
claims.how: Suricata signatures (corroboration-gated)

claims.name: Outbound Traffic Filtering
claims.how: resolver-bypass detection and Pi-hole / tarpit enforcement

claims.name: Per Host Download-Upload Ratio Analysis
claims.how: per-device upload volume (exfiltration); ratio with resp_bytes and the upload ledger in P1/P4

claims.name: Protocol Metadata Anomaly Detection
claims.how: DNS label shape / tunnelling; protocol facts from conn/ssl in P1

claims.name: Certificate Analysis
claims.how: ssl/x509 facts as observations

claims.name: Passive Certificate Analysis
claims.how: SNI / certificate binding from Zeek ssl/x509

claims.name: Client-server Payload Profiling
claims.how: named upload profiles, shape statistics (design N3/N4)

claims.name: File Access Pattern Analysis
claims.how: SMB file-operation observations

claims.name: Inbound Session Volume Analysis
claims.how: inbound-initiated flows per device

claims.name: Inbound Traffic Filtering
claims.how: UPnP / inbound exposure findings

claims.name: Relay Pattern Analysis
claims.how: proxyware / relay detector

claims.name: Web Session Activity Analysis
claims.how: account-level entities on trusted web services

claims.name: Remote Terminal Session Detection
claims.how: RDP / SSH / VNC / WinRM sessions from unusual peers

claims.name: RPC Traffic Analysis
claims.how: DCOM / RPC lateral sessions
